description: This file defines an abstract class 'Message' representing an HTTP message within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. The class manages HTTP method, path, query parameters, and headers, and includes methods for serialization and deserialization of HTTP message data.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract class representing an HTTP message, providing mechanisms for serialization, deserialization, and managing HTTP headers, path, method, and query parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTP message with specified method, path, query parameters, and headers, and acquires a native resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native resource associated with the message upon object destruction.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Serializes the message into a binary blob suitable for transmission.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the message components into a string buffer for transmission.

methods.name: _unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes a buffer into an HTTP message object, extracting method, path, query, and headers.

methods.name: pathAndQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns the request path including encoded query parameters.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the message.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns the query parameters as an associative array.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns the headers object associated with the message.
